title: How Limbitless Solutions is redefining adaptive sports with real-time 3D
summary: Discover how Limbitless Solutions’ Project Xavier uses Unity and facial muscle controls to make adaptive sports and wheelchair mobility training accessible.
body_markdown:
For many people living with progressive neuromuscular conditions, losing mobility often means losing access to the activities that once defined them. Sports become harder to participate in. Competition gives way to observation. And as physical abilities change, opportunities to build confidence, independence, and community can disappear.


But what if technology could help change that?


That's the vision behind[Project Xavier,](https://limbitless-solutions.org/ourResearch) an innovative adaptive EMG controller developed by[Limbitless Solutions](https://limbitless-solutions.org/) , a nonprofit research organization at the University of Central Florida. Recognized as an Honourable Mention in the[Unity for Humanity Awards 2026](https://unity.com/blog/unity-for-humanity-2026-winner-announcement) , Project Xavier is pioneering a new way for people with progressive neuromuscular conditions to compete, train, and maintain their independence using only facial muscle movements.


Powered by[Unity](https://unity.com/products/unity-industry) , the platform transforms subtle facial muscle flexes into precise digital controls, allowing participants to engage in adaptive sports while simultaneously building the skills needed for[real-world powered wheelchair navigation](https://www.fox35orlando.com/news/project-xavier-ucf-nonprofit-creates-hands-free-wheelchair) . By combining rehabilitation, competition, and play, Project Xavier is helping redefine what adaptive technology can achieve.
